reason: In our business buyers sign with people they've shaken hands with, not with someone a Sofia agency messaged on LinkedIn. I might take the free call to see the 15 companies, but I wouldn't put the pilot in front of my owner this month because the only proof is one logistics client, and we're manufacturers.
objection: A message with my signature that I didn't write could damage relationships it took me twenty years to build, and I doubt an outsider can explain our product well enough to get a buyer who is actually serious, not just one ticking a box for a call.
would_change_my_mind: If the 15 free target companies turn out to be ones I don't already know and that clearly fit, and they can show me a manufacturing or export client I can phone myself who got real quote requests, I would run the relationship-mode pilot.
